name: Giuoco Pianissimo — Main Line
description: The Quiet/Slow Variation of the Italian Game with 4.d3 — a patient, positional setup where both sides castle early and fight for long-term advantages.

lines.name: Giuoco Pianissimo (4.d3)
lines.description: White plays 4.d3 to build a solid center without committing to d4 immediately. Both sides castle by move 8, keeping the position flexible and strategic.
